leverage.exposure: No leverage open, balance positive, nothing to unwind today. The GitHub token has now been set on the worker, so the phone page should refresh on this publish; the mirror was silently skipped on the two earlier publishes because the token was absent, not because the push failed. Two defects still stand and both are worker-side. Transaction rows written without a market value cannot have one back-filled - re-sending the same row with the value added is dropped as a duplicate - so every run must supply it at first write, and today's observed transfers are permanently premium-less. And the bid-calibration line reports the premium against our own bid rather than against market value, which is what caused the underbid this morning; it should print both. Once the buys land, the discipline is fixed: the balance goes clearly negative, a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, and the sale that unwinds it must happen well before the lock.

binding_gap: Unchanged and still the constraint that orders everything. At the bare minimum there is no injury cover, only one formation is available, and no sale can happen until a buy lands. That is why the raise matters more than the money: the player is not an upgrade to a filled slot, he is the gate that unlocks a sale on a hard deadline. Adding two defenders would also open a second formation, which is what allows the worst forward to be benched rather than fielded.
verdict: Pipeline check after the GitHub token was set. The recurring schedule now runs the D1-backed prompt; the old Drive-based job is retired, so there is one memory and one page from here on. Nothing in the game has changed since the last pass. The action item stands and it is time-boxed: the Vagnoman bid needs raising before his listing closes this evening.
sell: Unchanged and still gated on a buy landing. Sylla is the urgent one: fit and starting, but his coach publicly backed him as a transfer candidate on 28.08, he is the worst scorer in the eleven, his value falls daily, and the window shuts tomorrow evening. Bernardo is the newer sell after being hooked at 53 minutes for his direct competitor. Lokonga is a quality sale, not an availability one. Widmer is confirmed benched but worth too little to unwind anything - keep him as the spare body.
buy: The Vagnoman bid must go up, and this is the one thing to act on today. Pulling Ebnoutalib's real market value showed the winning bid cleared at a premium in the high teens, while our losing bid was already well above the median - the calibration row that compares to our own bid rather than to market value understated this badly. Two of the last three contested Kickbase listings cleared above sixteen percent. So bid near the top of the observed band rather than just under ten percent over market value. The overpay is trivial against available spending power; losing him means another day at the bare minimum with the Sylla window shutting. He remains the best points-per-euro starter on the board - a full ninety at Bayern, publicly backed by his coach, at home to Koeln - against defenders priced at double for half the return. Maluze is unchanged: the offer is placed, already above the highest premium ever measured here, needs no raise, runs to expiry tomorrow midday. Eggestein stays the optional third leg, offered at market value rather than at an ask that has sat unsold for a week. Aouchiche, Diks and Reis are all genuine starters and all three are bad buys at their asks; the Bayern reserve keeper is a non-starter because the first choice is being rested from the cup specifically to be available.
movers: Unchanged. No manager asks below market value anywhere on the board, so the rival-flip mechanism is absent. The Kickbase-listing flip exists but the measured margin is a fraction of a percent - not worth carrying a negative balance into matchday week. Timing note that still applies: the daily value update lands tonight, and the Vagnoman listing closes shortly before it, so if he is won and his value ticks up, part of the premium comes straight back. A sweetener on the raise, not the reason for it.
fitness: No change since the dated sweep. No squad player injured or suspended, none in the current injuries-and-suspensions table. Watch items unchanged: Bernardo's early substitution for his direct competitor is a selection warning rather than an injury; the Bayern centre-back has live foreign interest until the window shuts tomorrow evening; Sylla's exit talk is the one that forces a decision. Three market listings still carry non-fit status flags and stay excluded. The newly listed Schalke midfielder is explicitly unverified and recorded as such.
